send_action_to_simulator: send a touch or key action to an Android simulator with screen dimensions and finger count
prepare_touch_action: convert an AndroidEnv action dict into simulator-ready touch event tuples with pixel coordinates
split_touch_action: split a multitouch action dict into a list of single-touch action dicts for each finger
lift_all_fingers_action: create a lift action dict that lifts all fingers at position zero for the given finger count
review_action_fns: review the action_fns module functions for converting actions between AndroidEnv and simulator formats
